products.name: Logseq AI
products.note: Open-source knowledge base; local-first; graph database; privacy-focused

profile_text.body:
Logseq describes itself as a privacy-first, open-source platform for knowledge management and collaboration. The company's site emphasizes local-first operation, meaning user data stays on the user's own device rather than being stored on external servers.

Its primary product, Logseq AI, is an open-source knowledge base built on a graph database architecture and positioned around privacy. The held facts categorize it under notes, knowledge, and meetings tooling.
